coverage.notes: The denominator is the number of public product URLs in the site's product sitemap at discovery time. Covered counts candidates with a processed verdict in this bounded task, not the whole catalogue. The sitemap can change between runs and is not independently audited.

business_acceptance.reason: Bounded framework-comparison trial; user acceptance pending.
business_acceptance.scope: First 30 selected product pages from the public product sitemap.

runtime.browser_cleanup: PlaywrightCrawler.run() returned; browser pool closed by the crawler.

notes: Bounded trial: the declared scope is 30 product pages or 10 minutes, whichever comes first.
Coverage covered counts processed candidates in this task, not the whole site.
Tax basis is UNKNOWN when the source page does not state inclusive/exclusive pricing.
Single-variant products have no meaningful options; options are left empty with a reason.
No model or other LLM is called at runtime.
This candidate does not implement pause/resume; every run purges its Crawlee queue and is a new task.
